prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production illustration atlas for original Korean photo booth stationery. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG image (highest supported resolution). Exactly SIX independent multicolor illustrations in a 3-column by 2-row grid, in reading order; one illustration per cell, large but with 70px clear transparent space to every edge of its 512px cell. Absolutely no grid lines. Real alpha transparent background, no white sheet and no checkerboard.
Art direction: carefully art-directed independent Seoul stationery studio, charming grown-up illustration, flat matte gouache and cut-paper screenprint with sparse colored pencil details. Intentional asymmetric silhouette, quiet rich colors, elegant understated commercial print design. Fine colored contours, very subtle irregular ink texture INSIDE shapes only, no shading glow or cast shadows. Sharp clean usable silhouettes. Not glossy 3D, not emoji, not generic vector clipart, not children's preschool graphics. Each motif should feel intentionally drawn as part of one cohesive print collection. NO text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, brand names, frame, photo slots, white sticker outlines, paper background, stray unrelated confetti. All objects fully visible, separate and uncropped.
Collection 61: 회식 / 술자리 (dinner-party). Palette: paper #F5E5CE and ink #A85E3A with the motif colors; background remains genuine transparent alpha. EXACT six separate motifs in reading order: 1. two golden beer mugs with ivory foam; 2. small clear soju glasses; 3. green bottle without branding or text; 4. cream snack dish; 5. orange citrus slice; 6. terracotta toast ribbon. Intimate grown-up Korean social dining stationery. Each motif isolated with at least 70px fully transparent gutters. Full silhouette; no words or numbers.
visualReview: Six isolated readable dining motifs. Sixth motif interpreted toast as two hands clinking soju instead of a terracotta ribbon; theme-congruent variation, not mislabeled as exact motif match. Beer silhouette approaches first-column gutter; root mechanical crop should use actual alpha bounds.
